title: Deeper/broader residual DXF-reader and public-viewer screen
mode: Primary-source repository/documentation review plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Screen residual DXF readers and CAD viewer repositories not yet named in the current route summary.
Resolve whether they add source-independent reader/writer evidence, a reproducible public codec, or a new implementation requirement.
Keep peer and consumer validation at the existing composed checkpoint and preserve the current local fast-test cadence.

sources.name: unitycoder/DXF-Reader
sources.observed: The repository identifies itself as forked from ixmilia/dxf and describes the IxMilia DXF/DXB reader/writer. Its README lists writer compatibility caveats for modeler/proxy/annotation entities and R13 files.

sources.name: rena0157/Dxflib
sources.observed: GitHub marks the project archived and read-only since 2019. Its README describes DXF reading, lists AC1006 through AC1027 versions, enumerates LINE, LWPOLYLINE, HATCH, ARC, CIRCLE, POINT, TEXT, and MTEXT as implemented entities, and lists writing as a future goal.

sources.name: mxcad/mxcadviewer-cpp
sources.observed: The public application describes DWG/DXF viewing, but its build guide requires a separately downloaded mxcadlib library in addition to Qt and OpenCascade. The reviewed public repository page does not bind that codec artifact to a source revision or license.

method.evidenceBoundary: Project pages establish only their own lineage, declared scope, repository status, and build dependencies. No parser behavior, independent expected values, native acceptance, or geometric semantics were measured.

evidence.topic: The IxMilia fork is not an independent parser lineage
evidence.observed: unitycoder/DXF-Reader explicitly identifies ixmilia/dxf as its fork source.
evidence.planUse: Keep any future observation grouped under IxMilia.Dxf unless a named fork-specific source change is pinned and reviewed; do not count a second reader/writer vote.

evidence.topic: The archived Dxflib project is a narrow read-only candidate
evidence.observed: Its own README documents a small implemented entity set and describes writing as future work; GitHub marks the project archived/read-only.
evidence.planUse: Retain discovery-only status. Do not use it to qualify writing, DWG, object/reference graph preservation, or 3D modeler semantics.

evidence.topic: A public viewer does not make its separately distributed codec source-inspectable
evidence.observed: mxcadviewer-cpp directs builders to separately download mxcadlib; the reviewed page does not provide an immutable parser-source/artifact/license binding.
evidence.planUse: Exclude it from open-source parser and semantic-oracle counts until the effective codec route is independently inspectable and reproducibly pinned.

nextActions: Continue the existing implementation queue; these candidates do not block local slices.
Admit a future peer only when it adds source-distinct evidence for a named gap; pin its exact artifact and expected-value manifest at the existing composed checkpoint.
Do not add the screened viewer/readers as routine dependencies, tests, or fixture sources.
